roster.parentPermissionHint: Required for any player under 18. Tap the ⓘ for the full consent disclaimer.
roster.consentBody:
For any athlete under the age of 18, a parent or legal guardian must grant permission before their information, evaluations, and film are collected, analyzed, or shared within BloomPrint.

By selecting “Yes,” you confirm that you have obtained verifiable consent from the player’s parent or legal guardian to create and maintain this profile — including the storage of biometric and performance data and the generation of AI scouting and development reports.

If the player is 18 or older, parental permission is not required and you may select “No.”

You are responsible for ensuring this consent complies with all applicable privacy laws, including COPPA and any local regulations governing minors’ data.
